fixtures.source: I didn't plan to keep the shop open past six — it just happened. The regulars kept coming in, and I'd rather sell another loaf than throw one out. Most nights it's quiet — two or three people, a dog, sometimes a kid with coins — and I don't mind. The till closes at nine now. I'm not sure it pays, but it's the part of the day I like best.
